decision: Close the child-panic confirmation as a narrow diagnostic SUCCESS with no external action. Promote pipeline completeness because it directly prevents false reassurance from a successful process that checked the wrong or incomplete object, and its producer, adapters, independent expectation, receipt semantics, fault rubric and finite controls are now bound.

categories.assessment: Pipeline completeness provides a reusable end-to-end assurance control across checkers; the child-panic diagnostic has reached its useful local endpoint.
The selected sentinel targets the unresolved gap between process success and intended checked-object identity. Its artifact and receipt contract can be reused by future corpus and contribution work.
The child-panic result changes only diagnostic location and warrants no upstream action. The completeness pilot remains local until it produces a validated reusable asset.
The plan reuses the pinned Arena lean4export producer, official and Lean4Lean adapters, normalized process handling and sampled-RSS supervision while adding the missing checked-object receipt layer.
The earlier receipt-semantics gate is satisfied by an independent twelve-declaration expectation, exact three-fault rubric and staged launch gates. No network or external coordination is required.

candidates.rationale: READY and unstarted. Exact local producer and adapter identities exist, expected contents precede generated artifacts, and implementation/production/execution phases have mechanical gates and finite process limits.
Still valuable, but its independent typing oracle and generator construction are less ready than the fully bound pipeline sentinel.

blockers.reason: Bind the independently reviewed typing rules, generator reuse decision and finite construction protocol before promotion.
